summary: Inventory/GUI textures no longer handle translucent pixels correctly

## The bug

If a texture file for an inventory screen is given translucent pixels, those pixels will render completely opaque in-game.

This was not the case prior to release 1.15 for many screens.

## Affected screens

Everything located in textures/gui/container (excluding gamemode_switcher.png) is affected by this issue:

 - Anvils

 - Beacons

 - Furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers

 - Brewing stands

 - Cartography tables

 - Crafters

 - Crafting tables

 - Dispensers and droppers

 - Enchanting tables

 - Chests (both sizes), trapped chests (both sizes), ender chests, minecarts with chests, barrels

 - Grindstones

 - Hoppers and minecarts with hoppers

 - Horses, donkeys, mules, llamas, trader llamas and camels

 - The Survival inventory screen

 - Looms

 - Shulker boxes

 - Smithing tables

 - Stonecutters

 - Villagers

 - Creative inventory screens

In addition, the following are also affected:

 - Book-and-quills and written books

 - Recipe Book

The advancements window renders translucent pixels correctly.

I am unable to test if the demo screen background is also affected, however the attached resource pack also retextures this.

## How to reproduce

 - Download and apply the attached resource pack: translucent-inventories-24w14a-v1.0.zip

 - Enter any of the aforementioned inventory screens

## Expected results

The inventory screen would be translucent.

## Actual results

It is not.

## Actual behavior

In Minecraft 1.15 and later, translucent pixels in most inventory and GUI textures are rendered as fully opaque. The texture’s RGB color is displayed, but its partial alpha value is ignored, so the world or GUI elements behind those pixels are not visible.

This affects the inventory textures in `assets/minecraft/textures/gui/container/` (except `gamemode_switcher.png`), as well as the book-and-quill, written-book, and recipe-book interfaces. Consequently, applying a resource pack with translucent versions of these textures produces solid, opaque areas instead of the expected semi-transparent inventory background.

The advancements window is not affected and continues to render translucent pixels correctly.
Expected Behavior: When a resource pack provides inventory or GUI textures with translucent pixels, those pixels should remain translucent when rendered in-game rather than becoming fully opaque. The affected inventory screens, books, and recipe book should display the supplied textures with their intended transparency, allowing the underlying background to show through consistently across the supported interfaces.
